usedFor: Base.com holds your online orders and invoices, and HubSpot receives them as deals through “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice” in Base.com, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each invoice becomes a HubSpot deal, so billed orders appear in your sales pipeline.

watchOut: “Update Deal” needs the HubSpot deal ID, so “Order Status Changed” can only update deals that already exist.
